entities.name: Filip Hrgović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Filip Hrgović is a Croatian professional boxer. He has challenged once for the IBF interim heavyweight title in 2024. As an amateur, he won the gold medal at the 2015 European Championships; and a bronze at the 2016 Olympics.
